purpose: Shows self-betrayal as one YES reshaping to fit three contradictory asks, leaving a countable record of conforming versions.
visualConcept: Three distinct asker molds, one YES conformed to each

elements.purpose: slot I: first asker's demand mold
first conforming YES inside slot I
slot II: second asker's reshaped demand mold
second conforming YES reshaped for slot II
slot III: third asker's demand mold
final conformed answer held in slot III
names the repeating betrayal: answer morphs for whoever asked

storyboard.spokenMeaning: You change your answer to match whoever asked — shape-shifting speech as self-betrayal.
storyboard.viewerTakeaway: My 'yes' bends into every asker's shape, so it stops being mine and stops meaning anything.

visualNarrative.action: Headline slides in left; on the right a vertical rail draws down and three different-proportion slots snap onto it, evenly spaced, each labelled empty.
visualNarrative.meaning: Three contradictory asks sit waiting on one line, countable before anything moves.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: One rail with three teal outline slots (wide, tall, thin) locked to the same axis, quick 0.2s stagger.

visualNarrative.action: The single solid YES slides right and stretches wide to lock edge-to-edge inside slot I.
visualNarrative.meaning: First asker: the answer takes their shape whole.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: The YES text visibly widens to fill slot I; no second YES exists anywhere.

visualNarrative.action: YES lifts to slot II and squashes tall, letters condensed but readable; a dim YES ghost stays in slot I.
visualNarrative.meaning: Second asker, opposite demand — conformity repeats and starts keeping a record.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Slot I holds a faint stretched YES while the solid condensed YES sits in slot II.

visualNarrative.action: YES drops into slot III as a thin sliver and holds; slot II keeps its dim tall YES; frame eases to a hold.
visualNarrative.meaning: Self-betrayal made countable: one word, three readable versions, none of them yours.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Final rail: three readable YES forms — two dim ghosts, one solid and thinned — on one axis.

semanticObjects.semanticRole: Names the behavior in the viewer's own words.

typographyPlan.headline: YOU CHANGE YOUR ANSWER TO MATCH

subtitlePlan.text: each time you bend your answer to match the asker, your 'yes' loses all value
subtitlePlan.timing: mid-beat, spoken over the second reshape

motionBeats.action: Headline slides from left; rail draws top-down, three slots snap in at 0.2s intervals, all placed by 1.1s.
motionBeats.purpose: Establishes the countable, aligned set of demands before the answer moves.

motionBeats.action: Solid YES scales from 0.9, slides and stretches horizontally into slot I with a brief contact highlight.
motionBeats.purpose: Conformity as an active act — the answer moves, the demand does not.

motionBeats.action: YES lifts to slot II with a short ease-out squash; a dim YES ghost fades into slot I.
motionBeats.purpose: Proves reshaping is repeatable and starts the readable record.

motionBeats.action: YES settles thinned into slot III, slot II's ghost fades in, frame holds the last half second.
motionBeats.purpose: Leaves the rail of three readable YES forms sitting with the viewer.

storyboard.compositionIntent: leftTextRightObject on 8% margins: headline anchors the left third, static. Right half holds one vertical rail with three slots on a shared axis, even spacing, all content kept above the subtitle band (bottom 20% clear). 60% negative space, six elements, single accent family on the object, gold only on CHANGE.
visualEvidence: Three differently-proportioned slots sit aligned on one rail with even spacing from step 1 onward.
One solid YES is seen re-forming into all three slots — never duplicated.
Ghosts are readable deformed YES words, not abstract shapes.
Only teal touches the slots; gold appears solely on the word CHANGE.
Final frame: three readable YES versions stacked on the rail, two dim, one solid.
forbiddenInterpretations: Scattered or floating slots at uneven heights — all three must sit on one rail at even spacing.
A gold-outlined slot or gold YES — gold is reserved for the word CHANGE; three separate solid YES copies are also forbidden, only dim readable YES ghosts may remain.
Slots entering later than 1.4s apart or sliding in one at a time from the frame edge; no content inside the bottom subtitle band.
Crossed-out or red strike marks, masks, chameleon, faces or costume metaphors for shape-shifting.
Eyebrow rows, subheads, labels or captions beyond the six elements.
storyboard.noveltyIntent: Prior beats used struck lines, split type and static grids; here one rail carries the whole argument — the single word's travel down it, stamping readable ghosts of itself, makes conformity countable in a single glance.
